column1: # Comparator numbers transcribed from the source papers. One row per (method, metric, protocol).
# `protocol` is load-bearing: a number is only comparable to a MuLAN arm trained on the SAME
# protocol. See README.md in this directory before using any of these.
# One caveat on the `pooled_spearman` / `clustered_id60` rows sourced from ProtBFF Table 2.
# `pooled_spearman` is the lookup key these rows have always carried, but the frontier papers
# report that split FOLD-AVERAGED -- Spearman within each test fold, then averaged -- which
# was determined on 2026-08-05 and is what experiments/BENCHMARK_MATRIX.md now states. The key
# is left as-is because it is referenced by plot_frontier_comparison.py; the metric it names is
# the source's, not a claim that the number is pooled. Fold-averaged and pooled differ by up to
# ~0.05 on a given arm, so a MuLAN value set against these rows should be read fold-averaged
# (spearman_foldavg in results_matrix_ps.csv). The ProtBFF verdict is the same either way.
